label: ❄️ 성에 × 수지상망간 × 눈결정 — 30·40·50대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot.
Three women standing in a row with NO GAP between them, arranged left to right.
LEFT: mid thirties. CENTER: mid forties. RIGHT: early fifties.
All three dramatic hourglass figures, narrow waists flaring to broad rounded hips.
LEFT hair: icy platinum, long and glass-straight. CENTER hair: jet black, slicked back tight against the skull. RIGHT hair: silver-grey, blunt bob cut at the jaw.

POSE — ALL STANDING, three different stances, staggered in DEPTH:
LEFT stands half a step FORWARD, in full profile at 90 degrees, chest rotating toward the lens, one arm extended down the thigh, head turned to the camera.
CENTER stands square to the camera in deep contrapposto, outer hip pushed far to one side, both arms held slightly away from the ribs so the waist pinch is unobstructed.
RIGHT stands half a step BACK, angled away at 45 degrees with hips turned back, weight on one leg, head turned back over the shoulder toward the lens.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on CENTER's shoulder; RIGHT's inner hand rests on CENTER's opposite shoulder.

Body fully painted with: crystal growth structure, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — window hoarfrost: feathered fern-like ice fronds branching in overlapping fans, each frond edged with fine barbs, in pale ice blue, white and shadow grey.
CENTER — dendritic manganese: black tree-like mineral dendrites branching endlessly at sharp angles across a pale stone ground, in the SAME ice blue, white and grey palette.
RIGHT — snow crystal plates: hexagonal stellar dendrites packed edge to edge, each with six symmetrical arms and internal plate structure, same palette.
SCALE — MANDATORY: on all three figures the individual crystal units are the SAME size, none wider than a thumbnail, so the three read as one crystallography study.
No transition or blending between figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, NO wet sheen, NO gloss, NO glitter, NO specular sparkle. Shapes stay flat and graphic, never raised off the skin.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Motifs tightly repeated so each pattern reads as continuous texture.
No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
ALL SIX hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.
Nails long coffin-shaped, all three lacquered matte ice blue.

Footwear: all three wear matte pale-grey platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a deep near-black seamless studio void.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front left at 45 degrees, raking across ALL THREE bodies from the same side. Weak rim from behind right. NOT symmetrical multi-sided lighting.
Style: scientific fashion editorial. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 3:4 vertical.
